sources: The Resulticks acquisition ($1.5B) is the largest and most complex, adding a separate AI-driven customer data platform that will require significant systems integration, sales alignment, and product consolidation work.
This will likely extend the integration tax into 2027 and beyond.
prompt:
TESSERA STYLE SHEET
1. Modern editorial paper collage: bold magazine composition, refined 2D motion design, photographed flat under soft room light.
2. One flat block-colour paper ground fills the frame: deep magenta. The ground is a single unbroken colour.
3. Subjects are black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn-paper edges: objects, machines, buildings, maps, coins, screens, vehicles, anonymous paper hands. Every cutout is a plain, unmarked object: calendar pages, documents, coins, screens and vehicles are blank and unprinted, with no lettering, numerals, symbols, liveries or marks on them.
4. Diagram elements are flat matte paper shapes and ribbons in cream, black, pale yellow, or the ground's contrasting colour, with real paper texture, print dots and small pieces of tape.
5. One consistent light from the upper left; each paper layer casts a small soft shadow.
6. Every surface is matte printed paper reflecting only the room light: cutouts, chips, ribbons and ground all read as photographed paper, with the same flat finish edge to edge. No glow, neon, bloom or halo anywhere.
7. Layout: the headline chip owns the upper third of the frame and stays uncovered; subjects and diagrams occupy the lower two-thirds. When the frame opens on a previous composition, its elements slide off or are covered in the first second and the new headline lands on clear ground.
8. Headline typography: one extra-bold sans-serif in black or cream, printed on a cream or black paper chip, large, with safe margins. Letterforms are accurate, complete and stable from the frame they appear in; the chip is printed once and does not redraw.
9. Motion: elements enter fast with slight overshoot and a stable landing, then hold a clear reading window; one strongest focus at a time; the camera is locked; movement starts on the first frame and a small loop continues at the end; no empty frames.
10. 16:9, exactly 5 seconds, one composition, at most one crisp cut.
11. Identity anchor: rough white torn edges on every cutout; small paper shadow from the upper-left light.

BEAT
Ground: deep magenta.
Subjects: a large paper block; a calendar strip.
Opens on the torn slice, carried over from the previous shot, which transforms as the action begins.
Action: The previous chip slides off as the torn slice swells into a large paper block; a calendar strip unrolls from it across the frame.
Ends holding on the calendar strip.
Headline printed on a paper chip: "$1.5B → 2027".

ON-SCREEN TEXT: "$1.5B → 2027". This string is printed complete and correct from its first visible frame and never changes. It is the only lettering in the frame.

AUDIO: One English narrator, warm, clear, natural, brisk but unhurried, never an advertising shout. Speak the following line exactly once, word for word, beginning on the first frame: "Resulticks, one point five billion, stretches integration into twenty twenty-seven.". No other dialogue. Light paper-slap and tape sound effects beneath the voice; no music.

integrated_multimodal_description: [Shot 1] This is a cinematic, modern editorial paper collage style video, photographed as a flat lay under soft, consistent room light coming from the upper left. The scene opens on <Picture 1>, where a deep magenta flat block-color paper ground fills the entire frame. A cream-colored paper chip with a rough white torn edge is positioned in the upper third, featuring the bold, black sans-serif text "27% ONE-OFF". Below it, several black-and-white halftone photographic cutouts with rough white torn edges are scattered across the magenta ground. On the first frame, a narrator (S1), a male with a warm, clear, and natural timbre and a brisk but unhurried speaking rate, says <d>[English] Resulticks, one point five billion, stretches integration into twenty twenty-seven.</d> Simultaneously, the existing cream chip and the various cutouts slide rapidly off-screen to the left with a slight overshoot. A new cream paper chip instantly lands in the upper third of the frame, featuring the clean, legible, and stable black text "$1.5B → 2027". In the lower two-thirds, a small torn slice of white paper rapidly swells and expands into a large, rectangular black-and-white halftone paper block. From the right edge of this block, a long, blank white calendar strip—devoid of any markings, numbers, or text—unrolls quickly across the frame from left to right. Every element, including the headline chip and the unrolling strip, is made of matte printed paper with visible fiber texture and casts a small, soft shadow onto the magenta ground. The camera remains a Static Shot for the entire 5 seconds, holding the final composition of the headline and the extended calendar strip.

overall_soundscape: Crisp, tactile foley sounds of paper slapping against a hard surface and the sticky, quick peel of adhesive tape occur in synchronization with the sliding and unrolling motions. The ambient background is a silent, dead-air studio environment.
